CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents found.

COD.rationale: Content (colored positions), organization (full-grid position lists) and status/origin metadata are all explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the identified contents' presentation/access was found.

C.rationale: The report identifies colored contents ('red'/'blue') with explicit coordinate lists for named referents/times.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are presented separately from explicit origin/status metadata for the same referents, showing a distinction between identified content and its status/provenance.

O.rationale: The text explicitly describes how contents are presented/organized (e.g. full-grid listings and partitioned candidate presentations) for named referents.
